description: Every custom module installs and upgrades on a fresh Odoo 19 CE database in CI
Every sudo() in tenant-facing modules is justified in a comment and listed in SECURITY_MATRIX.md
Each tenant database carries its country localisation (l10n_ae/l10n_sa/l10n_pk) installed by the bundle
Migrated or imported records carry source_system and source_record_id
The 25 crm.lead server actions of the C2P CRM live in a versioned module with tests and a dry-run mode
customization_justification: logic must be reviewable and reversible

description: Quotation to confirmed order to delivery to invoice to payment proven on a non-jewellery tenant with partial delivery and partial invoice
RFQ to PO to receipt to bill with 3-way match and partial receipt
Lock dates set per company; posted moves are corrected only by reversal
E-invoicing submissions are tested against sandbox endpoints with idempotent retries
Trial balance equals the sum of subledgers (AR/AP/bank/stock) at month end with a signed reconciliation
Delivery cost from timesheets flows to the portfolio project margin in the tracker
Platform agents use one governed policy (levels A-E; restricted data never sent; numbers only from the engine)
